description_en: Retrieves the details of an event rule
description_zh: 获取一个事件规则的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge get-rule --event-bus-name default --rule-name ram-changes --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the event bus
parameters.name: event_bus_name

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

Success: The request was successful.

Other values: The request returned an error code. For more information, see Error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。取值说明如下：

Success：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

CreatedTimestamp.description_en: The creation timestamp of the rule

EventBusName.description_en: The name of the event bus

FilterPattern.description_en:
The event pattern in JSON format. The following modes are supported:

stringEqual mode: In the map structure, each field can contain up to five expressions.

stringExpression mode: In the map structure, each field can contain up to five expressions
FilterPattern.description_zh:
事件模式，JSON格式。取值说明如下：

stringEqual模式：每个field最多5个expression（map结构）。
stringExpression模式 ：每个field最多5个expression（map结构）

Status.description_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

ENABLE: The rule is enabled. This is the default.

DISABLE: The rule is disabled
Status.description_zh:
规则的状态。取值说明如下：

ENABLE：规则已启用。规则默认状态。
DISABLE：规则已禁用

Concurrency.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent pushes

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the dead-letter queue
Arn.description_zh: 查询到的死信队列在阿里云上的统一资源标识（ARN）

Network.description_en: The network type of the dead-letter queue

DetailMap.description_en: The details of the event target

Endpoint.description_en: The delivery endpoint for the event

ErrorsTolerance.description_en:
The fault tolerance policy. Valid values:

ALL: Enables fault tolerance. Errors do not block event delivery. If all retries fail, the system sends the event to the specified dead-letter queue or discards it.

NONE: Disables fault tolerance. If an error persists after all retries, the system blocks event delivery
ErrorsTolerance.description_zh:
容错策略。取值说明如下：

ALL：允许容错。允许异常容错，当异常发生时不会阻塞执行，超过重试策略后会根据配置将消息投递至死信队列或直接丢弃。
NONE：禁止容错。不允许容错，当异常发生并超过重试策略配置时会阻塞执行

Id.description_en: The custom ID of the event target

ParamList.description_en: The list of parameters for the event target

items.description_en: A parameter for the event target

Form.description_en: The format of the event target parameter. For more information, see [Limits]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163289.html）
Form.description_zh: 事件目标参数的格式。更多信息，请参见[使用限制]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163289.html）

ResourceKey.description_en: The resource key of the event target. For more information, see [Limits]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163289.html）
ResourceKey.description_zh: 事件目标的资源参数。更多信息，请参见[使用限制]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163289.html）

Template.description_en: The template of the event target parameter
Template.description_zh: 事件目标参数模板样式

Value.description_en: The value of the event target parameter

PushRetryStrategy.description_en:
The retry policy for pushing events. Valid values:

BACKOFF_RETRY: A backoff retry policy. The event is retried 3 times at a random interval between 10 and 20 seconds.

EXPONENTIAL_DECAY_RETRY: An exponential decay retry policy. The event is retried 176 times over one day. The retry interval starts at 1 second and exponentially increases to a maximum of 512 seconds. The specific retry intervals are 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and then 512 for the remaining 167 retries
PushRetryStrategy.description_zh:
推送重试策略。取值说明如下：

BACKOFF_RETRY：退避重试策略。重试3次，每次重试的间隔时间是10秒到20秒之间的随机值。
EXPONENTIAL_DECAY_RETRY：指数衰减重试。重试176次，每次重试的间隔时间指数递增至512秒，总计重试时间为1天；每次重试的具体间隔为：1，2，4，8，16，32，64，128，256，512，512...512秒（共167个512）

Type.description_en: The type of the event target. For more information, see [Event target parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185887.html）
Type.description_zh: 事件目标类型。更多信息，请参见[事件目标参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185887.html）

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful. A value of `true` indicates success
